name: datatailr-dashboard
description: Live Datatailr platform dashboard in a pane of the Claude Code desktop app

installationsDir.title: Installations folder
installationsDir.description: Folder with one env file for each Datatailr installation. The file name without .env is the name of the installation.

cliPath.title: Datatailr CLI path
cliPath.description: Path to the datatailr CLI. If it is empty, the plugin searches the PATH of the Claude process. If you set it, the plugin uses only that path.

shareContext.title: Share pane context with Claude
shareContext.description: Let Claude see a short summary of what the pane shows
